[LSER.6.4] Companion-slot access reads the observation
declared on the slot. Cursor resolution per [LSER.6.11]
determines the (slot, label, backing) triple. If the slot
has multiple observations covering the same aggregation
under different time models, the cursor must carry a label
component per [LSER.6.8]. If only one observation covers the
aggregation, the binding-only cursor resolves directly.
